displayDescription: A glyph light bulb builds band by band on a phosphor monitor, then grows into an ASCII network: an idea becomes a connected system.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural CRT: phosphor persistence is approximated by an exponentially decaying ghost of each cell's previous glyph and a two-pass canvas blur bloom; no physical CRT simulation, shadow mask or scanlines (omitted to keep glyphs crisp).
Glass curve is suggested by a static radial falloff and inner shadow; glyph columns are kept straight to preserve grid alignment.
Menlo/Consolas system monospace font is used; every glyph is placed at integer cell centres, so the grid holds even if fallback font metrics differ.

STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action (density-band cell replacement) with a scene-chosen dark blue-black glass.
GSAP is loaded from the task-supplied local gsap.min.js; the dependency-selection tool could not record selections because this preview project has no dependency manifest.
